title: action.list, contract version 1
description: The actions the actor may run in the panel (GUARDRAILS 8, PRD 13.2, 13.4): every action of the compiled registry exposed on Inertia whose permission the actor holds on some node, as the PermissionRule decides it from the actor's grants, and the navigation entries the actor may open. The document carries nothing: the actor is never a field of a query, so the pipeline takes it from the credential alone, and every actor may run it without a permission while the anonymous principal may not. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Registry\Domain\Queries\ListActions, and the generated codec reads it and writes its canonical JSON: an object without members. Its result is action.list.result.v1.json.
